title: Foxhound
body:
Foxhound is a small pack I made containing a selection of Neoforge 1.21.1 mods that I either heard great things about, used older versions of, found around Modrinth, or mods that I/friends have had major involvement in.

I call it a "Glass of Water" modpack because its definitely not everything and the kitchen sink. Maybe some stuff and a glass of water.

The standouts include:
- [Pastel](https://modrinth.com/mod/pastel-mod), using magic from color!
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create), you know it, you love the machines hopefully.
- [Quark](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark), a mod whos port to 1.21.1 I had a hand in and I really adore.
- [No Mans Land](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-mans-land), a mod that was suggested to me that I really ended up enjoying.
- [Enderscape](https://modrinth.com/mod/enderscape), whilst it might not be up to snuff with its Fabric counterpart, its still really cool.
- [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight), so you can get some meals in too.
- And so much more!

Whilst as of right now there isn't many tweaks as of right now, I hope that in the future I can provide an experience thats more tightly knit. Regardless, I played through a good chunk of the pack on a single player world and had a blast.

It's also my first modpack. I named it after one of my favorite mobs in Quark (The Foxhound) and I hope that people can really enjoy it. I dont have a discord server or anything outside of a MC Server but if this gets like more than 30 downloads Ill consider it.

Thanks for playing my modpack thank you thank you thank you

- Siuol
